recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片細胞極度密集，幾乎被單一形態、小至中型、核深染的圓形細胞取代，正常三系造血難以辨認，提示原始細胞浸潤（急性白血病）；T 細胞系須以流式細胞儀判定。
features: Markedly hypercellular aspirate at low power
Monotonous population of small to medium round cells with high N:C ratio
Few recognizable maturing granulocytes, erythroid islands or megakaryocytes
Scattered clear spaces (fat) and blood background
Cytologic detail limited at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power is markedly hypercellular and diffusely replaced by a monotonous population of small-to-medium cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis, including megakaryocytes, is not readily identified. Nuclear and cytoplasmic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow replacement by acute leukemia, compatible with T-lymphoblastic leukemia given the clinical context; high-power morphology and flow cytometry are required for lineage assignment.

ddx.vs: Low-power appearance is identical; immunophenotype (CD19/CD79a vs cytoplasmic CD3) distinguishes lineage.
AML blasts usually have more cytoplasm with granules or Auer rods on high power and express MPO or myeloid antigens.
Burkitt cells show deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm and a mature B-cell phenotype (sIg+, TdT negative).
